artifact: Membership records (WP-4.1): the manifest payload, signed as a COSE_Sign1 of the profile in crates/permguard-objects/src/cose.rs by the coordinator's host.operations key, content type permguard.membership.manifest.v1, its kid that key's <ring>:<thumbprint>; the invitation, the pending membership and the journal entry the store keeps under host/members/; the enrollment and membership requests and answers a peer session carries
authority: 1-architecture/3-architecture-server-host-membership.md, 6-contracts/8-contract-host-api.md (Membership), owner decisions of 2026-10-09 (files, byte shapes, token proof, request digest, manifest delivery, identity reset); crates/permguard-host/src/membership/record.rs
encoding: deterministic CBOR (RFC 8949 core deterministic), integers in the signed 64-bit range

fields.name: host_id
fields.note: 16 bytes, a UUIDv7

fields.name: epoch
fields.note: the Host's identity epoch when it entered the membership, from 1

fields.name: fingerprint
fields.note: the Host's first fingerprint, `sha256:<hex>`: its pin

fields.name: retention_seconds
fields.note: each from 1; an approval lowers each, never raises one

fields.name: task_id
fields.note: lowercase letters, digits and `-`

fields.name: type
fields.note: policy.mirror, decisions.ship, events.ship, events.import, audit.checkpoints or zone.secrets

fields.name: provider_role
fields.note: coordinator or member, as the type fixes it

fields.name: consumer_role
fields.note: the other role

fields.name: selector
fields.note: inside the membership's selector

fields.name: assurance_requirements
fields.note: refused at approval while non-empty, until WP-4.2

fields.name: revoke_after_seconds
fields.note: longer than dormant_after_seconds

fields.name: owner
fields.note: coordinator or member: whose ring

fields.name: key_set_digest
fields.note: 32 bytes (key-set.json)

fields.name: binding
fields.note: the owner's ring binding, COSE_Sign1 (keys.json ring_binding)

fields.name: keys
fields.note: the RFC 7517 JSON of each published key, 1 to 64

fields.name: binding
fields.note: the owner's ring binding of that set, COSE_Sign1

fields.name: membership_id
fields.note: 16 bytes, a UUIDv7

fields.name: tasks
fields.note: 1 to 32

fields.name: member_assurance
fields.note: the profile the member declared

fields.name: min_assurance
fields.note: the invitation's floor

fields.name: epoch
fields.note: the fence: one more at every manifest, from 1

fields.name: previous
fields.note: the digest of the predecessor's envelope under `permguard.membership.manifest.v1\n`; absent exactly at epoch 1

fields.name: status
fields.note: active, suspended, revoked, rejected or expired

fields.name: invite_id
fields.note: 16 bytes

fields.name: token_key
fields.note: the Ed25519 public key whose seed is SHA-256 of `permguard.membership.token-key.v1\n` and the token: nothing the coordinator holds signs a proof

fields.name: expires
fields.note: at most 7 days after creation

fields.name: created_by
fields.note: the principal that issued it

fields.name: invite_id
fields.note: 16 bytes

fields.name: token_proof
fields.note: 64 bytes: the token key's Ed25519 signature over `permguard.membership.enroll.v1\n` ‖ coordinator host_id ‖ member host_id ‖ the connection's RFC 9266 exporter

fields.name: coordinator_address
fields.note: the member's copy: `https://<host>:<port>`

fields.name: identity
fields.note: the coordinator's copy: the member's presentation its enrollment session proved (session.json presentation)

fields.name: status
fields.note: pending

fields.name: action
fields.note: fetch or revoke

fields.name: membership_id
fields.note: the one the session names

fields.name: held_epoch
fields.note: the epoch the member holds: the answer carries the manifests after it

fields.name: manifests
fields.note: COSE_Sign1 manifests after the held epoch, oldest first

fields.name: ring_statements
fields.note: the coordinator's statements of the rings its manifests pin

fields.name: seq
fields.note: from 1

fields.name: kind
fields.note: invited, invite_revoked, enrolled, manifest, joined or orphaned

fields.name: subject
fields.note: the invitation's or the membership's id

fields.name: epoch
fields.note: a manifest's epoch

fields.name: operation_id
fields.note: the mutation that wrote it

fields.name: previous
fields.note: the digest of the entry before it under `permguard.membership.journal.v1\n`, of nothing for the first

fields.name: detail
fields.note: the record the entry concerns: an invitation, a pending membership or a manifest envelope

fields.name: statements
fields.note: on a manifest the coordinator issued: its statements of the rings that manifest pins, as they stood at the signature; absent when empty
